reason: Superseding spec E-20260927-01-r2 answers REV-20260927-07 with a provenance allowlist and logged payload checks that keep evaluator outcomes away from both judges, a predeclared invalid-call and retry policy with all-attempt cost and a 0.98 completion floor, a deterministic threshold tie rule, repeat dispatch reconciled with cost, per-split family and failure-cluster minimums with design-effect power and family-level flip bounds, and every missing packet item turned into a machine-checked not_runnable condition. It can still move B14 with a local calibration measurement and decides which judge gates the P3 harness, so it is worth running once policy and the harness exist.
